meta.name: IIT Guwahati
sources: Buildings: Overture Maps Foundation (OpenStreetMap, Google Open Buildings, Microsoft ML Buildings), ODbL
Land cover: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200, CC BY 4.0
Imagery: Sentinel-2 cloudless 2024 by EOX IT Services GmbH (contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

landmarks.name: Administrative Building
landmarks.desc: Houses the Director's office, the Deans and the institute's administrative sections.

landmarks.name: Dr. Bhupen Hazarika Auditorium
landmarks.desc: The main auditorium, named after Dr. Bhupen Hazarika, the legendary Assamese singer, lyricist and film-maker. Convocations, talks and cultural nights happen here.

landmarks.name: Conference Centre
landmarks.desc: Conference and seminar halls next to the auditorium.

landmarks.name: Central Library
landmarks.desc: Lakshminath Bezbaroa Central Library, with the Computer Centre alongside. The favourite place to study in exam season.

landmarks.name: Lecture Hall Complex
landmarks.desc: The big lecture theatres where first-year and institute-wide courses are taught. Look for the LH canteen nearby.

landmarks.name: Academic Complex
landmarks.desc: The heart of academics: interconnected blocks (the Cores) holding most departments, labs and faculty offices.

landmarks.name: Core 5
landmarks.desc: One of the academic core blocks at the western edge of the Academic Complex.

landmarks.name: Mechanical Workshop
landmarks.desc: Central workshop where first-years learn machining, welding and fabrication.

landmarks.name: IITG Lake
landmarks.desc: One of the many lakes that make IITG one of the greenest campuses in India. The lakeside is a favourite evening walk.

landmarks.name: Lakeside Food Stalls
landmarks.desc: Evening food stalls by the lake.

landmarks.name: Student Activity Centre
landmarks.desc: Club rooms and activity spaces for the student Gymkhana: music, dance, drama, photography and more.

landmarks.name: New SAC
landmarks.desc: The newer Student Activity Centre, with more halls for clubs and fest preparation.

landmarks.name: Athletics Track & Football Ground
landmarks.desc: The main sports ground with a running track. Inter-hostel sports and Spirit events happen here.

landmarks.name: Swimming Pool
landmarks.desc: The institute swimming pool in the sports complex.

landmarks.name: General Gym
landmarks.desc: The institute gymnasium.

landmarks.name: IITG Hospital
landmarks.desc: The campus hospital for students, staff and their families.

landmarks.name: Guest House
landmarks.desc: The institute guest house, beside the lake near the northern part of campus.

landmarks.name: Serpentine Lake
landmarks.desc: The largest lake on campus, winding through the green north-west of IITG.

landmarks.name: Market Complex
landmarks.desc: Shops, banks and eateries for daily needs.

landmarks.name: Food Court
landmarks.desc: Food court near the sports complex.

landmarks.name: Transit Complex
landmarks.desc: Transit accommodation on the eastern side of campus.

landmarks.name: Technology Incubation Centre
landmarks.desc: Where start-ups born at IIT Guwahati are incubated.

landmarks.name: Cricket Ground
landmarks.desc: The campus cricket ground: inter-hostel matches, and the open-air concert stage for the Techniche and Alcheringa Pronites.

landmarks.name: Children's Park
landmarks.desc: Park for the kids of the campus residential area.

landmarks.name: View Point
landmarks.desc: A lookout on the hill. On a clear day you can see across the campus lakes to the Brahmaputra valley. Best at sunset.

landmarks.name: Brahmaputra Hostel
landmarks.desc: Named after the Brahmaputra, the great river flowing just south of campus. Every IITG hostel is named after a river of the Northeast.

landmarks.name: Lohit Hostel
landmarks.desc: Named after the Lohit river of Arunachal Pradesh and Assam.

landmarks.name: Dihing Hostel
landmarks.desc: Named after the Dihing, a tributary of the Brahmaputra.

landmarks.name: Manas Hostel
landmarks.desc: Named after the Manas river, which flows from Bhutan through the Manas National Park.

landmarks.name: Umiam Hostel
landmarks.desc: Named after the Umiam river of Meghalaya.

landmarks.name: Barak Hostel
landmarks.desc: Named after the Barak, the major river of southern Assam.

landmarks.name: Kameng Hostel
landmarks.desc: Named after the Kameng river of Arunachal Pradesh.

landmarks.name: Gaurang Hostel
landmarks.desc: One of the newer hostels, named after the Gaurang river of western Assam.

landmarks.name: Siang Hostel
landmarks.desc: Named after the Siang, as the Brahmaputra is called in Arunachal Pradesh.

landmarks.name: Kapili Hostel
landmarks.desc: Named after the Kapili river of Assam and Meghalaya.

landmarks.name: Dibang Hostel
landmarks.desc: Named after the Dibang river of Arunachal Pradesh.

landmarks.name: Disang Hostel
landmarks.desc: Girls' hostel, named after the Disang river, a tributary of the Brahmaputra.

landmarks.name: Subansiri Hostel
landmarks.desc: Girls' hostel, named after the Subansiri, the largest tributary of the Brahmaputra.

landmarks.name: Dhansiri Hostel
landmarks.desc: Girls' hostel, named after the Dhansiri river of Assam and Nagaland.

landmarks.name: Married Scholars Hostel
landmarks.desc: Accommodation for married research scholars.

landmarks.name: Technology Park
landmarks.desc: The research park on the former east cricket ground: start-ups and industry labs in a cluster of new buildings around a plaza, next to the Technology Incubation Centre.

landmarks.name: IITG Bus Stop
landmarks.desc: The bus terminus: every campus bus starts here, in its bays between the Technology Incubation Centre and the Technology Park, and runs the loop round the campus.
